newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-CHIRAC SAYS WORLD CUP A SHOWCASE FOR FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHIRAC SAYS WORLD CUP A SHOWCASE FOR FRANCE.

text.p: French president Jacques Chirac said on Wednesday next year's World Cup finals would give France the opportunity to present itself as a modern country.

"The president wished for France to seize this opportunity to show a warm and friendly face, to be able to give a true showcase of its high technology, the image of a big country at the forefront of modernity," said government spokesman Alain Lamassoure after a cabinet meeting.
"Jacques Chirac stressed the importance for our country of organising the 1998 World Cup. He reminded us that there was only one year ahead of us to get ready.
"The whole of France must think of itself as a member of the French team," Lamassoure also quoted Chirac as saying.
